summary: The US-Iran conflict and the near-closed Strait of Hormuz dominate: oil near $100-115 is the main channel into inflation, the Fed and sector rotation, and Monday's Tehran talks are the swing factor. Next come the Fed's hawkish lean (December hike ~88% priced) and the Nov 3 US midterms; Israel's hung election, Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia and the Nov 1 OPEC+ meeting add oil-headline risk.

risks.title: US-Iran war and the Strait of Hormuz closure
risks.status: Saudi, Turkish and Pakistani officials met Iran's leadership in Tehran on Oct 26 and agreed to keep talking; Hormuz carried ~4 transits on Oct 18 vs ~85/day pre-war; US blockade of Iranian ports continues; Trump said Oct 23 the US may strike Iran again
affected: Energy supply squeeze theme (SLB, WMB, EOG)
risks.market_pricing: Brent ~$114.7 spot, WTI 99.99 (-1.7% today, +18% over 3 months); OVX 58.7 (92nd percentile); US SPR lowest since 1982
risks.impact: De-escalation is bearish oil/energy and bullish tech, transports and the consumer via lower inflation and hike odds; a collapse of talks or new strikes would push oil toward $120 and hurt long-duration equities

risks.title: Fed hiking path and Fed leadership (Chair Warsh)
risks.status: FOMC decides Oct 28 (hold expected); July had three hawkish dissents; futures price an 88% chance of a December hike
risks.odds: Oct 28 hold 92% / hike 8%; Dec 9 hike 88% (fed funds futures, Oct 27)
risks.impact: A hawkish statement or press conference hits long-duration tech and semis; a softer tone would extend the chip rebound

risks.title: US midterm elections
risks.status: Election Nov 3; prediction markets favour Democrats for the House, Senate close
risks.odds: Democrats win House ~88%, Senate ~51% (Polymarket via Crypto Briefing, late Oct, exact date unclear)
risks.market_pricing: VIX 17.54, no clear election premium yet
risks.impact: A split Congress is usually read as gridlock (limits new fiscal/tariff legislation); a Democratic sweep would raise policy uncertainty for health care, energy and taxes

risks.title: Israel election: hung Knesset
risks.status: Voted Oct 27; exit polls show Netanyahu's bloc ~50 seats, Eisenkot's ~52-53, Arab parties ~17-18 — no bloc at 61; final results may take days
risks.market_pricing: No visible oil reaction yet; Brent driven by Tehran talks
risks.impact: Prolonged coalition talks add uncertainty to Gaza/Iran policy; a change of government could shift the regional war path

risks.title: Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia and Red Sea shipping
risks.status: Saudi-led coalition destroyed three drones aimed at Riyadh and the south on Oct 26; unconfirmed Houthi claims on Yanbu
risks.impact: A hit on Saudi export infrastructure (Yanbu, the Red Sea alternative to Hormuz) would be a major oil shock

risks.title: OPEC+ output policy
risks.status: Core seven kept November output at September levels (Oct 4); August output ~5 mb/d below prewar; next meeting Nov 1
affected: Energy supply squeeze theme (SLB, WMB, EOG)
risks.market_pricing: WTI 99.99, Brent ~$115; sources expect no change before 2027
risks.impact: A surprise increase would be bearish oil and energy stocks; continued restraint keeps the supply squeeze in place

risks.title: Russia-Ukraine war and peace talks
risks.status: Local truce in one town from Oct 27; trilateral US-Ukraine-Russia technical talks planned in Abu Dhabi in the first half of November (Kremlin: ~Nov 10); Moscow says it 'needs peace, not a ceasefire'
risks.impact: Real progress would be mildly bearish for defense and European gas; a collapse keeps the defense theme supported

risks.title: China-Taiwan tensions and chip export controls / tariffs
risks.status: Chinese live-fire drills across multiple seas in mid-October (not an encirclement of Taiwan); a report says US tariffs on Chinese chips are delayed to June 2027 (unconfirmed date)
risks.market_pricing: SMH -7.5pp vs SPY over 1 month, mostly rates/AI-capex driven
risks.impact: New export curbs or a Taiwan blockade drill would hit semis first; a trade thaw would help

risks.title: Bank of Japan decision and yen
risks.status: BoJ meets Oct 29-30; one report says futures price ~26% odds of a hike (date unclear)
risks.impact: A surprise hike could unwind yen carry trades and pressure high-valuation tech; a dovish hold weakens the yen further

risks.title: US government funding / shutdown risk
risks.status: Status after the Oct 1 deadline not confirmed in this review (2026 already saw a 76-day partial DHS shutdown, Feb 14-May 1)
risks.impact: A lapse would delay economic data and dent Q4 growth; markets have usually looked through short shutdowns
